claims.claimText: A detection apparatus, comprising: a cantilever vibration gyro including a piezoelectric element which has a first side and a second side, the first side provided with a drive electrode and a pair of detection electrodes, the drive electrode disposed between the pair of detection electrodes with predetermined gaps, the second side opposed to the first side and provided with a common electrode, the cantilever vibration gyro vibrating by a drive signal input between the drive electrode and the common electrode and generating a pair of detected signals corresponding to Coriolis force from the pair of detection electrodes; bias applying means for applying a bias voltage to the pair of detection electrodes; adding means for adding the pair of detected signals; first phase delaying means for delaying a phase of the detected signal added by the adding means by a range larger than 45° and smaller than 90°; and amplitude controlling means for controlling the detected signal delayed by the first phase delaying means to a predetermined voltage amplitude and outputting the detected signal as the drive signal.
The detection apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the vibration gyro is caused to self-oscillate at a frequency higher than a resonance frequency of the vibration gyro.

A detection apparatus, comprising: a cantilever vibration gyro including a piezoelectric element which has a first side and a second side, the first side provided with a drive electrode and a pair of detection electrodes, the drive electrode disposed between the pair of detection electrodes with predetermined gaps, the second side opposed to the first side and provided with a common electrode, the cantilever vibration gyro vibrating by a drive signal input between the drive electrode and the common electrode and generating a pair of detected signals corresponding to Coriolis force from the pair of detection electrodes; bias applying means for applying a bias voltage to the pair of detection electrodes; adding means for adding the pair of detected signals; a first phase delaying means for delaying a phase of the detected signal added by the adding means by a first phase amount; amplitude controlling means for controlling the detected signal delayed by the first phase delaying means to a predetermined voltage amplitude and outputting the detected signal as the drive signal; differential amplifier means for differential-amplifying the pair of detected signals; a second phase delaying means for delaying the phase of the detected signal added by the adding means by a second phase amount different from the first phase amount; and synchronous detecting means for synchronously detecting the signal differential-amplified by the differential amplifier means based on the detected signal delayed by the second phase delaying means.
The detection apparatus according to claim 3, wherein the vibration gyro is caused to self-oscillate at a frequency higher than a resonance frequency of the vibration gyro.

A method of detecting an angular velocity using a cantilever vibration gyro including a piezoelectric element which has a first side and a second side, the first side provided with a drive electrode and a pair of detection electrodes, the drive electrode disposed between the pair of detection electrodes with predetermined gaps, the second side opposed to the first side and provided with a common electrode, the cantilever vibration gyro vibrating by a drive signal input between the drive electrode and the common electrode and generating a pair of detected signals corresponding to Coriolis force from the pair of detection electrodes, the method comprising: applying a bias voltage to the pair of detection electrodes; adding the pair of detected signals; delaying a phase of the detected signal obtained through the addition by a range larger than 45° and smaller than 90°; and controlling the delayed detected signal to a predetermined voltage amplitude and outputting the detected signal as the drive signal.
The detection method according to claim 5, wherein the vibration gyro is caused to self-oscillate at a frequency higher than a resonance frequency of the vibration gyro.

A method of detecting an angular velocity using a cantilever vibration gyro including a piezoelectric element which has a first side and a second side, the first side provided with a drive electrode and a pair of detection electrodes, the drive electrode disposed between the pair of detection electrodes with predetermined gaps, the second side opposed to the first side and provided with a common electrode, the cantilever vibration gyro vibrating by a drive signal input between the drive electrode and the common electrode and generating a pair of detected signals corresponding to Coriolis force from the pair of detection electrodes, the method comprising: applying a bias voltage to the pair of detection electrodes; adding the pair of detected signals; delaying a phase of the detected signal obtained through the addition by a first phase amount; controlling the detected signal delayed by the first phase amount to a predetermined voltage amplitude and outputting the detected signal as the drive signal; differential-amplifying the pair of detected signals; delaying the phase of the detected signal obtained through the addition by a second phase amount different from the first phase amount; and synchronously detecting the differential-amplified signal based on the detected signal delayed by the second phase amount.
The detection method according to claim 7, wherein the vibration gyro is caused to self-oscillate at a frequency higher than a resonance frequency of the vibration gyro.

An electronic apparatus, comprising: a detection apparatus including a cantilever vibration gyro including a piezoelectric element which has a first side and a second side, the first side provided with a drive electrode and a pair of detection electrodes, the drive electrode disposed between the pair of detection electrodes with predetermined gaps, the second side opposed to the first side and provided with a common electrode, the cantilever vibration gyro vibrating by a drive signal input between the drive electrode and the common electrode and generating a pair of detected signals corresponding to Coriolis force from the pair of detection electrodes, bias applying means for applying a bias voltage to the pair of detection electrodes, adding means for adding the pair of detected signals, a first phase delaying means for delaying a phase of the detected signal added by the adding means by a first phase amount, amplitude controlling means for controlling the detected signal delayed by the first phase delaying means to a predetermined voltage amplitude and outputting the detected signal as the drive signal, differential amplifier means for differential-amplifying the pair of detected signals, a second phase delaying means for delaying the phase of the detected signal added by the adding means by a second phase amount different from the first phase amount, and synchronous detecting means for synchronously detecting the signal differential-amplified by the differential amplifier means based on the detected signal delayed by the second phase delaying means; and controlling means for performing predetermined control based on an output of the synchronous detecting means.

The electronic apparatus according to claim 9, wherein the electronic apparatus is a digital camera equipped with a shake correction mechanism, and wherein the controlling means controls a correction amount of the shake correction mechanism.
